name: optcatalog_find_entry_by_name
description: OptCatalog::FindEntryByName scans the loaded catalog table for the first keyed entry whose keyName matches the requested name.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native OptCatalog lookup tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ae3c0 validates reading g_OptCatalog_EntryCount and g_OptCatalog_EntryTable, returning null for empty tables, skipping entries whose keyName is null, comparing the requested name to keyName with the inlined strcmp loop, returning the first matching entry, and returning null on miss.
The native OptCatalog smoke verifies first matching lookup, null-key skipping, missing-name null return, and empty-table null return.
